title: Line 9 and East Coast Lights: Sarnia to Montreal and Levis
dek: Line 9 is a two-shipper line: Suncor Montreal and Valero Levis hold about 130 kb/d of firm commitments each on a 300 kb/d pipe, and because the pair runs about 390 kb/d combined, at least about 90 kb/d of their supply is waterborne in aggregate. Everything above that floor is economics, not plumbing: neither plant has a structural marine leg.
